name: manual_2f4e16
claim: A Python git helper that runs subprocess in text mode must pass encoding utf-8. Without it, a non-UTF-8 locale can abort the hygiene gate before it reports findings.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 5324084599 comment 4109787026 on Perpetua-Tools PR 399. run_git now sets encoding utf-8 in both Perpetua-Tools repo_hygiene_core.py and orama-system repo_hygiene.py. Fixed in 0037cbe4bd5e8ba971464790fedec5e42341cbbc.
